review_notes: Independently read the complete canonical and rendered implementation and header, all 24 subject records, all 63 baseline facts, all 27 outgoing links, the complete current proposal, functionality document, both disposition ledgers, coverage artifact and unresolved artifact. The current proposal, rather than the different proposal embedded in the prior-result packet, is the object of this verdict.

All three proposed writes target owned functions and are supported. The animation write correctly distinguishes pointer acquisition from state-writing work, documents airborne preparation and the exact zero comparison, and qualifies the FallSpecial successor using the inspected x2224_b2 redirect and conditional landing consumer. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftDonkey/ftdonkeyspecialhi.c#L74-L88; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/ftcommon.c#L527-L539; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftCommon/ftCo_FallSpecial.c#L28-L59 and #L145-L155.

The physics write correctly describes a reversible per-invocation selector, not a proved one-way script phase. The common fall helper subtracts gravity and uses a strict terminal comparison. The stated zero, equality and NaN observations are source-level ordinary floating-point semantics, not claims about target exception modes or valid asset domains. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftDonkey/ftdonkeyspecialhi.c#L103-L118; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/ftcommon.c#L415-L468.

The collision write correctly specifies the local >=0 split, ordered predicates, callback restoration and clamping. Its new air-to-ground continuation statement is independently confirmed by the inline, which calls ftCommon_8007D7FC and then reads cur_anim_frame for Fighter_ChangeMotionState. This does not establish complete engine preservation semantics. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftCommon/inlines.h#L81-L89.

Additional independent finding within the proposal's explicitly deferred predicate-internal behavior: ftCliffCommon_80081298 is not a pure availability test. On its successful path it calls ftCliffCommon_80081370 before returning true. Consequently the local true branch calls that entry routine again. The predicate can also record an occupied ledge and make player-system calls on a false path. This supplements, rather than contradicts, the proposal's expressly local control-flow claim and its warning about predicate-internal effects. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/ftcliffcommon.c#L22-L48; code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/kinds/ftDonkey/ftdonkeyspecialhi.c#L149-L157. No claim of idempotence or a guaranteed final cliff state is accepted.

Additional independent finding: ft_80082708 updates collision-position bookkeeping, delegates to mpColl_8004B108, copies the resulting position back and returns a GroundOrAir value. It is not a side-effect-free boolean. The exact local false branch is proved; a full ground-loss interpretation requires the enum/domain and collision-consumer semantics, which remain deferred here. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/ft_081B.c#L393-L404.

Ground movement and clamp definitions were additionally inspected. ftCommon_8007CADC computes stick-scaled acceleration and target and delegates to ftCommon_8007CA80; zero target selects -gr_vel acceleration. ApplyGroundMovement projects acceleration and velocity using the floor normal, conditionally scaling acceleration by friction. ClampGrVel uses ordered comparisons against -max and +max. These support the retained movement-flow claims without proving valid attribute domains. Evidence: code://c302741689bd67c361cd7faadb221df3193992c3/src/melee/ft/ftcommon.c#L99-L174.

The active Donkey table supports the callback roles; neither numeric motion names nor rendered aliases were used to prove gameplay naming. The eleven parameter entities have no baseline facts. No register-allocation, section-layout or object-layout claim is accepted as proved.

The exact existing link records were reconciled with the link ledger. The two animation-pattern links and the conditional landing-lag relationship are supported. All named Spinning Kong and helplessness relationships remain explicitly unresolved; overlapping records are not merged or deleted.

Acceptance is limited to the three proposed writes and the specifically qualified or deferred baseline dispositions below. It does not resolve asset values, human-facing move names, effect identity/lifetime, complete collision semantics or compiled layout. No replacement proposal or mutations are supplied.
